thread:
Maya L: Heads up — onboarding sample app for Cloudflare Workers is failing for a new customer. Auth retries are firing twice and we're seeing `TypeError: require is not defined` from our SDK in the edge bundle.
Samir: ugh that sounds like the build picked the CJS entry on the worker runtime. Which package.json exports map are we shipping?
Maya L: current package.json has a naive dual-pkg setup: 
```json
{
  "main": "dist/cjs/index.js",
  "module": "dist/esm/index.js",
  "types": "dist/types/index.d.ts"
}
```
But Workers resolves differently and seems to pull main.
Derek: Cloudflare/Edge runtimes don't support `require`. If main points to CJS and there's no conditional exports, the bundler or runtime may prefer it. We need conditional exports with an `import` vs `require` map.
Samir: Agreed. Proposed minimal exports map: 
```json
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "import": "./dist/esm/index.js",
    "require": "./dist/cjs/index.js",
    "default": "./dist/esm/index.js"
  }
}
```
But I'm worried about older consumers and our own sample app builds.
Jen: For onboarding friction we should also update the sample app's bundler config to prefer `module` field and validate resolution in CI against Cloudflare (wrangler) + Node. Right now our sample CI runs only Node.
Nico: Types are a pain here — TS consumers need `types` to resolve to the right declarations. If we use conditional exports we should add `types` under exports or `typesVersions` to ensure `import` consumers get the same d.ts. Example: 
```json
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "types": "./dist/types/index.d.ts",
    "import": "./dist/esm/index.js",
    "require": "./dist/cjs/index.js"
  }
}
```
Maya L: Another wrinkle: our auth/retry layer exhibits duplicate retries only in edge envs. Hypothesis: bundler is tree-shaking but ends up with two copies of the retry wrapper (one from esm build and one from cjs polyfill) so backoff triggers twice.
Derek: Possible. Duplicate modules can happen if both builds export the same symbol under different ID paths. We should confirm by checking the runtime bundle for duplicate copies of `retry.ts`. Also check `peer` vs `bundled` deps — sometimes consumers bring their own copy of our helper.
Samir: Quick repro script: run wrangler dev + add console.log in retry wrapper to see stack traces. I can PR a fix to the sample app to assert single instance.
Jen: For DX, could we switch sample bakery to always import from `redwood-inference/browser` (esm-only shim) for edge samples and keep dual pkg for Node examples? That keeps onboarding simple.
Nico: That works if we maintain the shim and its types. We should add a smoke test that runs the browser/worker sample with wrangler during PRs for SDK changes.
Maya L: Sounds good. Action items: Samir will add conditional exports + types export, Derek will instrument retry wrapper to detect duplicate instances, Samir + Jen will update sample app CI to run wrangler smoke test, Nico will add typesExports in package.json. I'll follow up with a tiny changelog blurb so support can triage customers hitting this.
deploy-bot: CI job `sdk/wrangler-smoke` queued for branch `samir/dual-exports`.
Samir: I'll open the PR after the smoke job run to verify. Thanks everyone :heart:
